newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil quiet, support from crud.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil quiet, support from crud.

text.p: Low sulphur straight run was pegged steady to a touch firmer on Wednesday with support derived from stronger crude.

Only two or three small parcels were heard available, set against one firm bidder. Sellers remain reluctant to let product go given crude's rise and the fundamentally tight supply situation. One seller with 20,000 tonnes at the end of the month was looking for mid $140s fob NWE.
Russian high sulphur material was still on offer. Up to three E-4s were thought unsold, but the higher numbers of close to $140 cif where putting off buyers, traders said.
